title: Mario & Luigi: Superstar Saga - Let's Go (Battle)
description:
This is the normal battle theme from Mario & Luigi: Superstar Saga (Mario & Luigi RPG).

This version is sampled, and there are actually 2 different sampled versions included: one with a variety of samples and one with samples exclusively from Yoshi's Island. (I may also do a Super Mario RPG one in the future.)
